profile_operations.input: Configuration id; body ignored; validates stored draft.

profile_operations.input: Configuration id; no expected_version body. Authenticated actor UUID required.
profile_operations.output: Configuration record after immutable revision publication.
profile_operations.meaning_and_lifecycle: Revalidates draft; rejects same fingerprint409; transactional CAS on loaded draft_version/published_revision; stores revision fingerprint/publisher. Afterwards enqueue_role only if global+role enabled. Queue phase occurs after commit.
profile_operations.tests: T1 direct publish helper+worker path with IDP/Agentic doubles; no handler wire/concurrent publish race assertion.

profile_operations.meaning_and_lifecycle: Requires live eligible role membership and draft validation. Creates independent preview job and pending run atomically, operation/run id initially equals job id. Can execute while feature/role disabled. Never updates latest pointer. May consume model cost;202 is only queue receipt.
profile_operations.tests: Source reviewed only; no retained preview enqueue/route/SDK wire execution test. Browser fixture returns synthetic202 and is not backend proof.

profile_operations.meaning_and_lifecycle: Enabling requires published revision; enqueue_role observes global gate. Disabling cancels configuration jobs and clears leases. Current SQL updates all configuration job statuses, including completed/failed rows. Stored run history stays separate.
profile_operations.tests: T1 direct enable/disable and latest/history behavior; no PATCH handler wire.

profile_operations.input: role_id required; user_id optional defaults authenticated UUID. Other ListQuery keys accepted but unused.
profile_operations.meaning_and_lifecycle: Self/read_all check and deployment fence. Disabled hides content. Cached inactive membership returns ineligible. Current revision+completed job => fresh; previous valid result can remain ready+stale after failed refresh. No LLM.
profile_operations.tests: T1 direct latest fresh/stale/ineligible/disabled reads; no HTTP/SDK wire.

profile_operations.meaning_and_lifecycle: read_own forced to actor subject; explicit other subject forbidden; read_all still deployment scoped. SQL parameter filters and stable created_at DESC,id DESC order; offset pagination. History includes previews/status outcomes.
profile_operations.tests: T1 direct list cross-subject denial only. Positive paging/filter/SDK wire not covered.

profile_operations.meaning_and_lifecycle: Deployment query then readable subject check. Authorized history persists when configuration disabled; configure/manage alone insufficient.
profile_operations.tests: T1 direct forbidden own-other/configure+manage and allowed own history. No HTTP/SDK wire.

profile_operations.input: ListQuery filters user_id?,role_id?,status?,page?,per_page? same clamp/order as summaries.
profile_operations.output: Page of job DB records, excluding preview_configuration,lease_token,requested_by.
profile_operations.meaning_and_lifecycle: Manage permits operational queue inspection independently of result read. Generated result is stored separately; current redaction always removes listed fields.
profile_operations.tests: Source reviewed; no retained jobs list/redaction/pagination HTTP or direct positive test.

profile_operations.meaning_and_lifecycle: Per-pair lookup config by deployment+role, live eligibility, enabled/global check; immediate coalesced non-preview enqueue. No read permission required/no result returned. Batch is sequential/non-transactional; partial queue side effects may occur before a later error.
profile_operations.tests: T1 direct enqueue coalescing helper, not refresh handler/batch limits/partial error/SDK wire.

profile_operations.meaning_and_lifecycle: Only failed job updated to pending; attempts0,last_error null,operation_id null,due now. Otherwise409. Eligibility/global/revision rechecked later in worker, not this update.202 is not successful generation.
profile_operations.tests: Source reviewed; no retained retry-handler or preview-retry lifecycle wire test.
